title: StarkFitness
tagline: An stake based fitness competition app based on starknet that allows you to compete with yoursefl
description: Using starknet native AA users create an account, users can create fitness challenges , to start the competition users will stake some USDC or any other token, if you dont complete de challenge you can not unstake. Connect your google fitness account to log your fitness progress and validate the challenges.
how_its_made: Using Dynamic providers, we connect to starknet wallets, users then set the challenge they want to have and stake the tokens. Once the user have created the challenge you need to connect to google fit api to get and calidate your data, in case you did finish the challenge ypu can unstake
